name: world-sync-extras
author: Lil Art
description: World Sync's playable content and iRO's quests, in blocks you can switch: the Jormungandr saga (Episodes 20 and 21), Chapters 1 and 2 of the Song of the World Tree, Varmundt, Star Forest and Herosria, iRO services, iRO Quests (Bounty Boards, City Investment, the 2021 town quests, Gramps and more), and names and descriptions for 3,800 items your client doesn't know. The official NPCs still without logic stand where the clients put them, and @npcplace moves any NPC. Needs Ragnarok Offline 1.6.9 or later.

settings.label: Jormungandr saga: Episodes 20 and 21
settings.description: Episode 20 starts from Horuru in the Ice Castle (Episode 19 done, level 200+); Episode 21 from Voglinde in the Ice Castle's west wing (level 230+). Includes the memorial dungeons, the dailies and the traders and enchanters. Turned off, its NPCs leave the Jormungandr maps entirely (their placeholders don't come back).

settings.label: Jormungandr: start Episode 20 without Episode 19
settings.description: Horuru offers Episode 20 to any character of level 200 or more, even one that hasn't finished Issgard's Episode 19 story.

settings.label: Varmundt, Amatsu, Juno Library, Chapters 1-2
settings.description: The Fantasy Book "Dungeon Food" in Prontera's east library (100+), Varmundt's Chess Garden and Deep Abyss (250+), Seoyeon's Trial in Amatsu (70+), Chapter 1 from the small ash trees near Prontera and Payon (200+), Chapter 2 in Yongjirak and Ragsruth (225+), the Juno Library's VR books (200+) and the mansion's eroded wing (265+). Turned off, its NPCs leave those maps.

settings.label: Star Forest, Herosria and Ash Village
settings.description: The Star Emperor job change in the Meteor Forest (TaeKwon Masters, base 99 / job 50: Nalson in Payon), Sanctuary Herosria's Garden of Dawn (portals in the four castle realms) and Ash Village's shops, enchants and signposts at the edge of the World Tree. Turned off, their NPCs leave the maps (their placeholders don't come back).

settings.label: iRO services: the Devil in the Box, market catalogs, Eden's Dungeon Teleporter and town helpers
settings.description: The Clock Tower's Devil in the Box and her Unknown Basement dailies (level 200+), stall search in the markets, the Catalogue Magician, Eden's Dungeon Teleporter and iRO's own services (Keiki, Aperture, the Shadow Blacksmith, Madogear rental), Izlude's Increase AGI acolytes and the Acolytes' training in the Izlude Sunken Ship. Turned off, they leave.

settings.label: iRO quests: Bounty Boards
settings.description: iRO's Bounty Boards in 28 towns and dungeons: hunt 150 of a monster for EXP, zeny and Eden Merit Badges. Turning them off keeps everyone's hunts in their quest log.

settings.label: iRO quests: Criminal Activities
settings.description: iRO's Criminal Activities Quest (Base Level 70): free Vince Noir's band from Jymmy the Thumb, from Geffen to the domestic airship. Starts with Agent York in the Geffen inn.

settings.label: iRO quests: Eye of the Beholder
settings.description: iRO's Eye of the Beholder (Base Level 50): help Beho the beholder win Bianca's heart in Rachel. Starts with the Beholder on the international airship's deck.

settings.label: iRO quests: Overlook Water Dungeon
settings.description: iRO's Overlook Water Dungeon (Base Level 30-85): the Byalan copy under The Sign west of Geffen, with its 15 Aged monsters and 5 floor hunts. Turning it off removes the monsters and the hunts.

settings.label: iRO quests: Gramps' weekly turn-ins
settings.description: iRO's Gramps at the Eden Group (Base Level 70-150): 400-kill hunts, two monsters a week per tier, for 400x the monster's EXP, 65,000 zeny and an Eden Merit Badge. Replaces rAthena's talk-only Gramps.

settings.label: iRO quests: City Investment (Merchant Union)
settings.description: Join the City Merchant Union at the Eden Group, earn Union Insignias from monsters and requests (113 deliveries, weekly Wanted bosses), invest them in 9 cities and buy their Union gear. Masha in Alberta hires out street stall staffers. Replaces akreao's City Unity mod, which turns itself off while this is on: untick this and restart to play City Unity (the staffers go off too).

settings.label: iRO quests: Town quests (2021 revamp)
settings.description: kRO's 2021 town quests that iRO runs: so far Morroc, Payon, Prontera (with Orc Village and Glast Heim), Izlude, Aldebaran and the Juno fields, Hugel, Einbroch, Lighthalzen, Geffen, Rachel, Veins, Comodo, Alberta, Juperos and the dungeon-mission givers, with their dailies, shared with the Eden Group's mission boards.

settings.label: Entrances into the World Sync maps
settings.description: 34 portals from towns and fields into Biosphere, Jormungandr, Chapter 2 and other maps World Sync fills. Only turn this on if your client has those maps (recent iRO/kRO data): without them the game hangs on the loading screen.

settings.label: Place the official NPCs that have no logic yet
settings.description: 72 NPCs from the official clients' maps and signboards. 44 of them already work (storage, guild storage, inns, repair, channel switches, the Varmundt elevator, Jormungandr's contact points, market guides); the rest greet you until their quests and services are written.

settings.label: @npcplace: move NPCs in game (GM)
settings.description: Stand next to an NPC and type @npcplace to move it where you stand or nudge it; the spot is kept across restarts. @npcplace list shows what you moved.
